name: SQUAD
summary: A progressive refinement technique for rapid and accurate 3D selection, where the system repeatedly narrows a group of candidate targets until the intended object can be selected.
howItWorks: Sphere-cast to select a group of objects, then pick repeatedly from a four-way menu that splits the remaining candidates until one is left.
advantages: Selecting small, dense, or distant targets when many objects are close together and a single pointing action may not be accurate enough.
limitations: SQUAD may require multiple refinement steps, so it can be less efficient for simple targets that can be selected directly. It is most useful when the initial selection is ambiguous.
